title: Committee of Supply – Head T (Ministry of National Development)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head T (Ministry of National Development)

sections.label: Dual-income households and HDB income ceiling
sections.summary: Rising median income and better-paying jobs mean dual-income households may surpass the $14,000 HDB income ceiling around age 30.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: Given the rise in median income and ability of our younger generation to secure better paying jobs, this meant that a dual-income household will easily surpass the current HDB total income ceiling of $14,000 around the age of 30.

sections.label: Singles BTO income ceiling
sections.summary: Singles buying flats under the Single Singapore Citizen Scheme face the same BTO challenge, with an income ceiling of $7,000.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: The same BTO challenge applies for singles purchasing flats under the Single Singapore Citizen Scheme where its current income ceiling threshold is $7,000.

sections.label: EASE extension to private property owners
sections.summary: The EASE programme will be extended to private property owners, as announced by Prime Minister Lawrence Wong.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: Second, Enhancement for Active Seniors (EASE) programme for private property owners.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: I am very heartened to hear Prime Minister Lawrence Wong's announcement that the EASE programme will be extended to private property owners.

sections.label: EASE programme details and commencement
sections.summary: The Minister is asked to elaborate on the EASE programme for private property, its commencement, work scope and subsidy support.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: Can the Minister elaborate on what the EASE programme for private property entails and when it will commence.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: Will the programme begin with EASE 2.0 work scope and what would the subsidy support look like?

sections.label: Elderly couple's HDB wait-out appeal
sections.summary: A couple nearing their eighties caring for a handicapped son hope to downgrade to an HDB flat but failed appeals to waive the 15-month wait-out period.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: Given that he and his wife's age are both nearing eighties and they are caring for a handicapped son in his forties, they hope to downgrade to an HDB flat while they are still mobile.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: However, they have repeatedly failed in their appeal for waiver on the wait-out period of 15 months in order to purchase a 5-room flat.

sections.label: Housing exemptions for special needs families
sections.summary: The Ministry is asked to introduce special exemptions for families with special needs adults and to consider housing for those past 55 in Adult Disability Housing.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: However, families with special needs adults form a very small proportion of all our housing needs.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: I hope the Ministry can introduce special exemptions that would allow these families greater flexibility in choosing a suitable flat, whether they are purchasing a new home or downgrading to a more manageable space.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: Another area for the Ministry to consider is how to cater for those living in Adult Disability Housing as the current enrolment age is between 18 and 55 years old.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: Should some families be unable to care for them at a later age and begin to look for housing option when their charges are past 55 years old, how can they be cared for as these special needs adults are incapable of self-care?

sections.label: Families moving for understanding community
sections.summary: Families move multiple times seeking a more understanding community, and the Ministry can help them secure safe, supported homes.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: Some families are compelled to move multiple times in search of a more understanding community.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: I believe the Ministry can play a role in alleviating these struggles by ensuring that such families have options in securing homes where they feel safe and supported.

sections.label: Grants for resale versus BTO buyers
sections.summary: HDB resale flat buyers get more grants than BTO buyers because BTOs are already subsidised while resale flats are market-priced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: HDB resale flat buyers are offered more grants than buyers of BTO flats, as BTOs are already subsidised by the HDB, whereas resale flats are priced at the market rate.

sections.label: CPF grants for resale flat buyers
sections.summary: The policy of increasing CPF grants for resale flat buyers, last revisited in August last year, aims at affordability but may raise resale prices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The policy of increasing CPF grants for resale flat buyers was last revisited in August last year and it seeks to make HDB resale flats more affordable for resale flat buyers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: But this policy can have the perverse effect of sellers raising prices even more and new buyers chasing ever-increasing resale prices.

sections.label: Option to top up CPF Special Accounts
sections.summary: It asks whether resale flat buyers could put part of the CPF resale grant into Special Accounts instead of the entire grant going to the purchase.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: For resale flat buyers who qualify for resale flat grants, would the Government consider giving resale flat buyers the option of putting aside a portion of the CPF resale grant, to top up their CPF Special Accounts, instead of allowing the entire grant to be deployed for the resale flat purchase?

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: To illustrate, a first-time couple aged 35 years of age, deploys $25,000 of the grant directly into their CPF accounts and assuming each party tops up just $200 a month to their accounts from the ages of 35 to 55, at a 4% interest in the Special Account, each of them would see this grant compound to slightly more than $125,000 by the time they reach 55 years of age.

sections.label: HDB resale market rising sharply
sections.summary: The speaker says the HDB resale market has risen sharply in recent years and continues to rise, needing intervention.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong)
sentences.text: Yet, in my view, there is one major issue that still needs intervention and that is our HDB resale market – which has risen sharply in the last few years and continues to rise.

sections.label: Separate buyer stamp duty for HDB flats
sections.summary: The speaker suggests a separate buyer stamp duty framework for HDB flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan (Jurong)
sentences.text: Specifically, I suggest we have a separate buyer stamp duty framework for HDB flats.

sections.label: BTO and EC income ceiling
sections.summary: A question asks whether MND would raise the income ceiling for BTOs and ECs and increase EC supply.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
sentences.text: With this in mind, would MND consider raising the income ceiling for BTOs and executive condominiums (ECs), as well as increasing the supply of ECs?

sections.label: HDB coffee shop budget meals
sections.summary: HDB targeted all HDB-leased coffee shops to offer budget meals by 2026, with lunch or dinner typically $3.50 and below and drinks $1.20 and below.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: HDB had set the target to have all coffee shops leased from HDB to offer budget meals by 2026.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Budget meals include lunch or dinner options that are typically priced at $3.50 and below, and drinks priced at $1.20 and below.

sections.label: CIPC funding for HDB estates
sections.summary: CIPC funding is an important source of Government grants for improving HDB estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Community Improvement Projects Committee (CIPC) funding is an important source of Government grants for improving HDB estates.

sections.label: CIPC nomination process change
sections.summary: Before 2021 opposition Town Councils needed agreement of CCCs under PA advisors; in 2021 MND changed CIPC nominations so Town Councils could also propose projects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Prior to 2021, opposition Town Councils had to seek the agreement of the various Citizens' Consultative Committees under the charge of unelected People's Association (PA) advisors, including losing PAP candidates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In 2021, MND correctly changed the process for making CIPC nominations and Town Councils, in addition to CCCs, were allowed to propose projects for funding.

sections.label: EASE open to all ages
sections.summary: The EASE programme is open to persons with disabilities regardless of age, on a case-by-case basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Hua Han (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The EASE programme is actually open to persons with disabilities regardless of age, on a case-by-case basis.

sections.label: Clarify EASE for all ages
sections.summary: MND should make it clearer that persons with disabilities of all ages can also benefit from EASE.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Hua Han (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: MND should make it clearer that persons with disabilities of all ages can also benefit from EASE.

sections.label: Hougang lift upgrading blocks
sections.summary: MP asks why lift upgrading was offered to Block 833 but not five other Hougang blocks lacking same-floor lift access.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Chairman, I speak again on the issue of lift upgrading for the five blocks of HDB flats in Hougang Single Member Constituency (SMC), namely Blocks 363, 830, 831, 832 and 835, where there are still some flats which do not have same-floor lift access.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: While I am glad that lift upgrading was offered to 10 more HDB flats at Block 833 last year, I hope the Minister can explain what the changes in circumstances for Block 833 were which do not apply to the other five blocks.

sections.label: Lift Access Housing Grant
sections.summary: The Lift Access Housing Grant remains unavailable to many residents, with about 140 HDB blocks lacking same-floor lift access as of January 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: As for the Lift Access Housing Grant, this is still not an option for many residents with whom I have spoken to.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: I was previously told by the Minister for National Development that, as of January 2023, there were about 140 HDB blocks with units without same-floor lift access.

sections.label: Nanyang segmented blocks
sections.summary: Of 140 segmented blocks, 14 blocks, or 10%, are in Nanyang, affecting 224 households.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: Out of the 140 segmented blocks in Nanyang, 14 blocks, or 10%, are in Nanyang, affecting 224 households.

sections.label: Support for segmented flat owners
sections.summary: MP urges HDB to let owners sell segmented flats back at market price, prioritise BTO applications, waive resale levy and give subsidies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
sentences.text: Two, when adding lifts is not feasible or too costly, I urge HDB to consider the following: allow owners to sell their segmented flats back to HDB at market price, ensuring they are not financially disadvantaged; grant these owners the priority to apply for BTO flats, similar to first-time applicants, to improve their chances of securing a new home; waive the resale levy for owners who sell their segmented units and buy a BTO flat, removing a significant financial barrier; provide additional subsidies for purchasing another flat, with even greater support for families with members who have mobility issues.

sections.label: Block 536 lift numbers
sections.summary: MP seeks clarification on why Block 536 has two lifts while similar Blocks 528 and 532 have three.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Although these three blocks are identical in design, Blocks 528 and 532 are served by a total of three lifts whereas Block 536 is only served by two lifts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Some residents of Block 536 shared with me that there used to be three lifts serving the block until the LUP was carried out.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: They have concerns over the wait times for the lifts and are confused why their block is seemingly deprived of one lift compared to the other two blocks of the same design.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I therefore seek clarification from HDB on how it determines if a block has a sufficient number of lifts serving it, and secondly, on specifically on Block 536, why two lifts were deemed sufficient for this block, and I do hope that HDB can address this issue and provide the appropriate assistance to the residents of Block 536 of Bedok North Street 3.

sections.label: Including private estate residents
sections.summary: MP says private estate residents must be included in ageing, sustainability and recognition initiatives, and welcomes their inclusion in several schemes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: However, when addressing issues like ageing, sustainability and recognising citizens' contributions, it is crucial to include private estate residents.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: I appreciate the Government’s responsiveness to us MPs in advocating for these residents, ensuring their inclusion in initiatives like the Merdeka and Pioneer Generations Packages, Community Development Council (CDC) Vouchers, MND's EASE programme, Climate Vouchers and SG60 Vouchers.

sections.label: Task Force for Consultants
sections.summary: The Government established a Task Force for Architectural and Engineering Consultants in September 2024, co-led by Indranee Rajah and Chaly Mah, focusing on four key areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
sentences.text: Chairman, in September 2024, the Government established the Task Force for Architectural and Engineering Consultants to tackle critical challenges in the built environment sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
sentences.text: The taskforce, co-led by Minister Indranee Rajah and Surbana Jurong Chairman, Chaly Mah, has been focusing on four key areas: one, enhancing the sector’s branding to attract young talent; two, modernising workforce to future-proof the industry; three, evolving business models to boost competitiveness; and four, promoting sustainability in line with Singapore’s green goals.

sections.label: EASE 2.0 for Seniors
sections.summary: Many seniors benefit from highly subsidised home fittings under EASE 2.0, which helps frail seniors live more safely at home.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
sentences.text: Today, many seniors benefit from highly subsidised home fittings under EASE 2.0, which helps frail seniors live more safely at home.

sections.label: MND Support in Private Estates
sections.summary: MND is extending efforts to private estates, including EASE 2.0 and EUP-Silver Estate, and is asked to explore spaces for AACs and assisted living.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
sentences.text: This year, MND is extending these efforts to private estates, ensuring that seniors outside of HDB estates also receive meaningful support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
sentences.text: This includes the rollout of EASE 2.0 for private estate seniors and the introduction of the Estate Upgrading Programme (EUP)-Silver Estate, which will enhance common spaces and walkways to better support ageing residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Kebun Baru)
sentences.text: Beyond these efforts, can MND explore setting aside spaces in larger parks within private estates to host AACs as well as to help assisted living providers secure affordable locations near private estates, ensuring accessible home care and assisted living services for seniors who need them within the private estates?

sections.label: Ageing in Place and Reverse Mortgages
sections.summary: A study found eight in 10 older adults prefer to age in their current homes; MND is asked about applying Lease Buyback learnings and reverse mortgages for private estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Chairman, a study by the Centre for Research on Successful Ageing (Rosa) at the Singapore Management University (SMU) found that eight in 10 older adults in Singapore prefer to age in their current homes, indicating a desire for familiarity and stability.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: However, for the group that is asset-rich and does not have sufficient cash resources, home improvements to suit their needs may not be an option.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: We are glad that MND has implemented EASE 2.0 to ensure that all seniors are able to age-in-place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: With the successful implementation of the HDB Lease Buyback Scheme since 2009, has MND distilled learnings from the programme that can be applied to the private home market?

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: While there are reverse mortgage packages available in the open market, would it be possible for MND to work with the banks to come up with reverse mortgage packages designed to suit the needs of seniors in private estates?

sections.label: Bird Culling and Flat Maintenance
sections.summary: NParks is asked to devise a strategy to curb pest birds, and MND is urged to increase support for maintenance and repairs in older flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: To curb the population of these birds, which have become pests due to their numbers, would NParks please devise a new, holistic strategy?

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I have three recommendations for MND to enhance Singaporeans' quality of life by optimising spaces and resources in our neighbourhoods.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: But first of all, I would like to urge an increase in support for the maintenance and repairs in older flats.

sections.label: Waterproofing and HDB Manpower
sections.summary: The seven-year repair cycle is called insufficient; MND is urged to fund more frequent waterproofing and enhance HDB building and infrastructure manpower.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The current seven-year repair and redecoration cycle is insufficient.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I urge MND to allocate additional resources for more frequent waterproofing maintenance in older flats to ensure safer living conditions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In many cases, rectification works can drag for months to years, with residents having to bear with the water dripping into their homes, damage to furniture and fall risk aside, they often have to take leave from work for inspections with relevant personnel, ranging from Town Council property officers to HDB engineers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I urge MND to look into manpower and capability enhancements for the building and infrastructure group at HDB to help the team do their work better.

sections.label: Town Council defect rating rule
sections.summary: A Town Council averaging more than four defects per block a year is downgraded to amber, and the speaker urges MND to remove this rule and allow community food gardens.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: If the Town Council averages more than four defects per block in a year, its maintenance rating is downgraded to amber in the Town Council Management report.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I urge MND to remove this rule and introduce a structured framework, allowing residents to cultivate these small plots as community food gardens.

sections.label: Community gardening partnership and award
sections.summary: Citizen-led groups would partner the Government, and the speaker suggests expanding NParks' Community in Bloom programme with a "Community in Abundance" award for fruitful harvests.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Organisations like the Circle for Human Sustainability, Edible Garden City and Project Black Gold, that talks about soil health, are examples of citizen-led groups that would love to partner the Government in this effort.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I suggest that the very popular Community in Bloom programme run by NParks to be expanded with a new award category "Community in Abundance" to recognise gardeners whose efforts yield consistent and fruitful harvest.

sections.label: Private estates in enhanced EUP
sections.summary: The speaker and residents welcome including private estates in the enhanced Estate Upgrading Programme to help elderly residents age in place.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Chairman, my residents and I welcome the inclusion of private estates in the enhanced Estate Upgrading Programme (EUP) to help our elderly living in these communities age in place.

sections.label: Expediting private estate repair works
sections.summary: The speaker asks how MND will ensure repair and upgrading works in private estates are carried out expeditiously given safety and health concerns.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: How will MND ensure that repair and upgrading works in private estates are carried out expeditiously in view of safety and health concerns for residents?

sections.label: Holistic strategy for HDB deterioration
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether HDB would consider a holistic strategy for a sustainable, longer-term solution to systemic deterioration of affected HDB blocks instead of ad hoc repairs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Instead of ad hoc repairs, would HDB consider a holistic strategy to provide a sustainable, longer-term solution to deal with the systemic deterioration of affected HDB blocks?

sections.label: GRA share of repair cost
sections.summary: The GRA helped residents pay for their share of 25% of the repair cost.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The GRA helped them to pay for their share of 25% of the repair cost.

sections.label: VERS criteria review request
sections.summary: Asks whether the Ministry can review VERS criteria case-by-case if there are no SERS plans, depending on block condition.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: If there are no plans for SERS, can the Ministry review the criteria for Voluntary Early Redevelopment Scheme (VERS) on a case-by-case basis, depending on the particular condition of the blocks?

sections.label: Amber Road zoning change proposal
sections.summary: A proposal was made in the constituency to change a plot at Amber Road from Reserve site to Residential Zone.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: In my constituency, there was a proposal to change the zoning of a plot of land at Amber Road from Reserve site to Residential Zone.

sections.label: Traffic impact measures questioned
sections.summary: Asks what measures will minimise traffic impact and how confident URA or LTA is that they will work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: When I filed a Parliamentary Question in January this year, I was told that measures will be introduced to minimise traffic impact.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: What are these measures and how confident is URA or LTA that these measures to manage will actually work out?

sections.label: Built Environment transformation progress update
sections.summary: Asks for an update on industry transformation progress and upcoming efforts since the refreshed Built Environment Industry Transformation Map launched in September 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: The Government launched the refreshed Built Environment Industry Transformation Map in September 2022, three years ago.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: Can the Government provide an update on the progress of industry transformation and some of its upcoming efforts to further accelerate this transformation?

sections.label: Breastfeeding lactation room requirements
sections.summary: Welcomes amending the Code on Accessibility in the Built Environment to lower GFA requirements for lactation rooms, benefiting breastfeeding mothers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: On the issue of breastfeeding, I am grateful for her and her team for consulting and working together with the Breastfeeding Mother's Support Group to effect changes that will help so many breastfeeding mothers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I am glad we will amend the Code on Accessibility in the Built Environment to lower GFA requirements for lactation rooms which will benefit many breastfeeding mothers.

sections.label: Single unwed parents PPHS eligibility
sections.summary: Asks why single unwed parents do not qualify for PPHS while divorced or widowed single parents do.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Why do single unwed parents still not qualify for the Parenthood Provisional Housing Scheme (PPHS)?

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Single parents who are divorced or widowed qualify for PPHS, so why not single unwed parents?

sections.label: Unwed parents PPHS eligibility
sections.summary: Single unwed parents should be treated the same as others and allowed to qualify for the PPHS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Single unwed parents should be treated the same as others when applying for PPHS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We should end the discrimination and allow them to qualify for the PPHS.

sections.label: Mandatory cat sterilisation in HDB
sections.summary: Mandating sterilisation of pet cats as a prerequisite for keeping cats in HDB flats can resolve fast reproduction and caterwauling.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Cats reproduce very quickly and unsterilised cats caterwaul.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: These are two important issues we need to resolve and we can do this through mandating the sterilisation of pet cats as a prerequisite for the keeping of cats in HDB flats.

sections.label: Adjournment Motion on common spaces
sections.summary: Three years ago, the speaker filed an Adjournment Motion on building harmonious communities through responsible use of common spaces in public housing estates.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: Chairman, three years ago, I filed an Adjournment Motion on building harmonious communities through responsible use of common spaces in public housing estates.

sections.label: Rooftop access registration and fee
sections.summary: Non-residents must register and pay a $6 fee to access the 50th storey rooftop via a turnstile gantry, limited to 200 visitors daily.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: Non-residents need to register and pay a $6 fee to access the 50th storey rooftop via a turnstile gantry.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: Visitor numbers are limited to 200 per day.

sections.label: Hougang flat fire hoarding hazards
sections.summary: The Hougang flat fire killed a family of three hoarders in January, bringing hoarding hazards and deadly consequences to the fore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: The hazards and deadly consequences of hoarding were brought to the fore by the Hougang flat fire, which killed a family of three hoarders in January.

sections.label: Deterrent and pigeon disease warning
sections.summary: This may deter hoarders, and pigeons carry bacteria and parasites transmittable to humans through their droppings.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: This may serve as a strong deterrent and warning to some hoarders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan
sentences.text: It is a known fact that pigeons carry various bacteria and parasites which can be transmitted to humans through their droppings.

sections.label: Pest bird problems
sections.summary: Pest birds steal food, leave droppings, create early morning noise and can injure residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan
sentences.text: Pest birds steal food, they leave droppings on clothes and all over the place, create noise very early in the morning and, in extreme cases, cause injury to residents.

sections.label: Municipal operations pilot expansion
sections.summary: The 2024 Committee of Supply announced MSO expanded its integrated municipal operations pilot to Pasir Ris-Punggol, with possible scaling to more estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan
sentences.text: Chairman, it was announced in the 2024 Committee of Supply that MSO has expanded the integrated municipal operations pilot to cover Pasir Ris-Punggol; and if the pilot continues to produce good results, MSO will scale this to more estates.

sections.label: SPCA animal cruelty cases
sections.summary: In 2024, SPCA reported 961 confirmed animal cruelty and welfare cases, the highest in 12 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: In 2024, the Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (SPCA) reported 961 confirmed cases of animal cruelty and welfare concerns – the highest in 12 years.

sections.label: Animals and Birds Act review
sections.summary: NParks has initiated a review of the Animals and Birds Act to strengthen animal welfare and health protections.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry
sentences.text: In response to these developments, the NParks has initiated a review of the Animals and Birds Act to strengthen protections for animal welfare and health.

sections.label: New Sengkang West park
sections.summary: In July 2024, URA proposed an inter-agency team with NParks and JTC to build a park around Sengkang West Industrial Estate.

sentences.speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, in July 2024, URA announced an exciting proposal that it will form an inter-agency Government team, with NParks and JTC, to build a new park around Sengkang West Industrial Estate, which is in Jalan Kayu and next to Cheng San-Seletar constituencies as well as Fernvale constituency, all of which are part of the Ang Mo Kio GRC.

sections.label: City in nature vision
sections.summary: MND announced the vision to transform Singapore into a city in nature in 2020.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: MND announced the vision to transform Singapore into a city in nature back in 2020.

sections.label: Coral restoration project launch
sections.summary: NParks launched the 100k Corals Initiative in December last year to plant 100,000 corals in degraded reefs and new sites.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: In December last year, NParks launched its most ambitious coral restoration project yet, the 100k Corals Initiative, which aims to plant 100,000 corals in degraded reefs and new sites.

sections.label: Second Marine Park designation
sections.summary: The proposed designation of the Second Marine Park at Lazarus South Kusu Reef was significant amid competition for sea space and climate change.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: The proposed designation of our Second Marine Park at Lazarus South Kusu Reef was a significant one, amidst the crowded competition for the use of our sea space and climate change.

sections.label: EASE 2.0 take-up update
sections.summary: MND was asked for a progress update on EASE 2.0 take-up, including uptake and demographics of seniors who benefited.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Could MND provide a progress update on the take-up rate of the EASE 2.0 programme since its introduction, including the uptake and demographic of seniors who have benefited?

sections.label: SERS residents relocation help
sections.summary: An MP asked what else can help SERS-affected residents at Ang Mo Kio Avenue 3 Blocks 562 to 565 relocate, especially elderly who envisioned ageing in place.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: On behalf of my residents affected by SERS at Ang Mo Kio Avenue 3, Blocks 562 to 565, I would also like to ask what else can be done to help these residents in their relocation, especially the elderly who envisioned being able to age in place?

sections.label: HDB flats completed and BTO supply
sections.summary: HDB completed all 75,800 pandemic-delayed flats in January and is on track to exceed launching 100,000 BTO flats from 2021 to 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In January this year, HDB caught up on the delays and completed all 75,800 flats that were affected by the pandemic.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Second, we ramped up supply of new housing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We are on track to exceed our commitment to launch 100,000 BTO flats from 2021 to 2025.

sections.label: First-timer BTO application rates
sections.summary: First-timer family BTO application rates stabilised below pre-COVID-19 levels, from 3.7 times in 2019 to 2.1 times in 2024, and 1.5 times in February 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: As a result, BTO application rates for first-timer families have stabilised to below pre-COVID-19 levels, from 3.7 times in 2019 to 2.1 times in 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In the most recent February 2025 sales exercise, first-timer family application rates fell further to 1.5 times subscription.

sections.label: Private residential property prices
sections.summary: Private residential property prices rose 3.9% in 2024, down from 6.8% in 2023 and 8.6% in 2022, while housing supply will be increased.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Private residential property prices increased by 3.9% in 2024, compared to 6.8% in 2023 and 8.6% in 2022, but we will keep pushing on to increase housing supply, to help more Singaporeans meet their housing needs.

sections.label: First Mount Pleasant BTO project
sections.summary: The first of six Mount Pleasant BTO projects launches in October 2025 with about 1,500 units of 2-room flexi to 4-room flats, including public rental flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The first of six BTO projects in Mount Pleasant will be launched in October 2025.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The first Mount Pleasant project will be a sizeable development, with approximately 1,500 units of 2-room flexi to 4-room flats, including public rental flats.

sections.label: First-timer family grants
sections.summary: First-timer families can now receive up to $120,000 in grants, with lower middle-income households getting more support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: First-timer families can now receive up to $120,000 in grants, with lower middle-income households getting more support.

sections.label: Standard Plus Prime classification
sections.summary: The new flat classification framework categorises BTO projects into Standard, Plus and Prime, and the first Mount Pleasant project will launch as Plus or Prime.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In October last year, we took another big step with the new flat classification framework, categorising BTO projects into Standard, Plus and Prime.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will launch the first Mount Pleasant project as either Plus or Prime.

sections.label: Resale flats reaching MOP
sections.summary: New flats reaching MOP will jump from 8,000 this year to 13,500 next year, rising to 19,500 in 2028, giving more resale market options.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We expect to see a larger supply of flats entering the resale market, providing options for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: There will be a significant jump in the number of new flats reaching MOP, from 8,000 this year, to 13,500 next year, and this will steadily increase until we hit 19,500 in 2028.

sections.label: First-Timer Parents booking flats
sections.summary: About nine in 10 First-Timer Parents' and Married Couple applicants have so far been invited to book a flat for 4-room or smaller Standard flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: About nine in 10 First-Timer Parents' and Married Couple applicants have so far been invited to book a flat when they applied for a 4-room or smaller Standard flat.

sections.label: PPHS flat supply doubled
sections.summary: All eligible married applicants with children aged 18 and below were invited to select a PPHS flat, and PPHS supply will double from 2,000 to 4,000 flats this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In recent exercises, all eligible applicants who are married with children aged 18 and below have been invited to select a PPHS flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will double PPHS supply again from 2,000 to 4,000 PPHS flats this year.

sections.label: 2-room Flexi BTO flats
sections.summary: Up to 14,000 2-room Flexi BTO flats will be launched from 2024 to 2026, with the majority set aside for singles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In fact, we will launch up to 14,000 2-room Flexi BTO flats from 2024 to 2026 and the majority of these will continue to be set aside for singles.

sections.label: Second-timer BTO allocation quota
sections.summary: The second-timer allocation quota for 3-room and larger BTO flats will increase by five percentage points to let more second-timer families buy BTO flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And these include families which have grown and others who may wish to right-size due to financial reasons.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Therefore, we will allow more second-timer families to buy BTO flats by increasing the second-timer allocation quota by five percentage points for 3-room and larger flats.

sections.label: EC supply increase
sections.summary: For those with incomes up to $16,000, EC supply this year will increase to around 1,500 units, up from around 1,200 units in previous years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For those with incomes up to $16,000, we will be increasing EC supply this year to around 1,500 units, up from around 1,200 units in previous years.

sections.label: EASE(Private) senior fittings subsidies
sections.summary: EASE(Private) will be available to Singaporean Citizen households in private properties with a senior aged 65 and above, or aged 60 to 64 needing ADL assistance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: EASE(Private) will be available to Singaporean Citizen households living in private properties with at least one senior aged 65 years and above, or who are between 60 and 64 years old and require assistance with at least one of the Activities of Daily Living (ADL).

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: More than 70,000 households will be eligible for subsidies to engage contractors to install a basic list of senior-friendly fittings in their homes, such as grab bars.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The Government will subsidise 75% of the cost of these fittings, with the subsidies capped at $1,200.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: EASE(Private) is targeted to commence early next year and will be a three-year pilot programme for a start and then, we will have a review.

sections.label: Cash bonus for right-sizing seniors
sections.summary: An additional $10,000 cash bonus will be provided to seniors who right-size to two-room flats or Community Care Apartments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: First, we will provide an additional $10,000 cash bonus to seniors who right-size to two-room flats or Community Care Apartments.

sections.label: Second round HIP upgrading
sections.summary: A second round of Home Improvement Programme upgrading will be done for flats from around the 60- to 70-year mark.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Meanwhile, we will do a second round of Home Improvement Programme (HIP) upgrading for flats from around the 60- to 70-year mark.

sections.label: R&D investment for HDB
sections.summary: Around $10 million will be invested in R&D over the next few years to build HDB's capabilities under three pillars.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will push on with research and development (R&D) over the next few years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We plan to invest around $10 million in R&D to build HDB’s capabilities under these three pillars.

sections.label: ABSD regime for complex projects
sections.summary: The Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty regime will be revised for developers who undertake complex projects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: To better support developers in their transformation efforts, we will revise the Additional Buyer’s Stamp Duty (ABSD) regime for those who undertake complex projects.

sections.label: CORENET X and BETC Grant
sections.summary: The ABSD remission timeline extension qualifying period for smaller projects is extended to 31 December 2026, and a $100 million BETC Grant over five years is introduced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Additionally, to encourage early adoption of CORENET X for smaller projects, the Government will extend the qualifying period for the ABSD remission timeline extension for these projects until 31 December 2026.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will also introduce the Built Environment Technology and Capability (BETC) Grant to support the sector in long-term building capabilities that extend beyond immediate project investments.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will set aside $100 million over five years.

sections.label: HDB unit launches
sections.summary: Over 50,000 HDB units will be launched in three years, over 100,000 between 2021 and 2025, and 3,800 units with shorter waiting times this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In the next three years, we will launch over 50,000 HDB units.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: This is equivalent to one Ang Mo Kio town.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: This means that between 2021 and 2025, we will launch over 100,000 units, exceeding our previous target.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: This year, we will also launch 3,800 HDB units with shorter waiting times of two-plus years.

sections.label: Bonus for right-sizing seniors
sections.summary: From 1 December 2025, seniors who right-size to 2-room Flexi flats or Community Care Apartments will receive an additional $10,000 bonus.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: From 1 December 2025, seniors who right-size to 2-room Flexi flats or Community Care Apartments will receive an additional $10,000 bonus.

sections.label: Silver Housing Bonus extension
sections.summary: The Silver Housing Bonus will be extended to private property owners with Annual Value below $31,000, from below $21,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Currently, the Silver Housing Bonus is only available to private property owners with Annual Value below $21,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We will extend the scheme to private property owners with Annual Value below $31,000, allowing them to benefit as well.

sections.label: Revitalising the city
sections.summary: Three efforts are shared: engaging Singaporeans on Draft Master Plan 2025, transforming the built environment sector, and enhancing city accessibility and inclusivity.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Today, I will share how we are working closely with our stakeholders to revitalise our city for the future: first, we will continue to engage Singaporeans on our Draft Master Plan (DMP) 2025, even as we prepare for the mid-year launch of the DMP2025; second, we will transform the built environment sector to strengthen our productivity and sustainability; and third, we will continue to enhance the accessibility and inclusivity of our city.

sections.label: DMP2025 public engagement
sections.summary: Since October 2023, URA has engaged over 175,000 people on DMP2025 themes: a happy healthy city, sustainable growth, nature and heritage, and urban resilience.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Since the DMP2025 public engagement was launched in October 2023, the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) has engaged over 175,000 people on its key themes, which are: one, shaping a happy, healthy city; two, enabling sustainable growth; three, stewarding nature and heritage, and four, strengthening urban resilience.

sections.label: Long Island coastal protection
sections.summary: Long Island, studied under DMP2025, would protect against rising sea levels, mitigate East Coast floods, add a freshwater reservoir, and create space for growth.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: We have ambitious plans for coastal protection against the impacts of climate change.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: These include the “Long Island” currently being studied as part of DMP2025. "Long Island" is a good example of how we use imagination and innovation to overcome our land constraints and address multiple challenges with an integrated solution.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: First, "Long Island" will protect against rising sea levels; second, it will mitigate floods for the low-lying East Coast; third, it will increase our water supply resilience with the creation of a new freshwater reservoir; and finally, it provides optionality for growth, through the creation of new spaces for housing, jobs and recreation, for future generations of Singaporeans.

sections.label: Task Force on Heritage Businesses
sections.summary: MND and MCCY have set up a Task Force on Heritage Businesses, Traditional Activities and Cultural Life.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: MND and the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY) have set up a Task Force on Heritage Businesses, Traditional Activities and Cultural Life.

sections.label: Built environment sector support
sections.summary: Support included the $1.36 billion Construction Package, legal and foreign worker support, and progress toward 70% IDD and DfMA adoption by 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: To help the sector, the Government provided a slew of support, including significant financial assistance through the $1.36 billion Construction Package; legal support for firms unable to meet their contractual obligations due to the pandemic; and support for contractors to bring in foreign workers, as they were faced with manpower shortages when we restarted construction works.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Mr Lim Biow Chuan has asked for an update on the progress of the BE Industry Transformation Map (ITM) efforts.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: We are on track to hit our target of 70% by 2025 for both the adoption of Integrated Digital Delivery (IDD), which enables greater collaboration between stakeholders, and Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DfMA), which shifts construction offsite to safer and more productive settings before onsite assembly.

sections.label: New Built Environment Technology Grant
sections.summary: The Government will introduce a new BETC Grant, setting aside $100 million over five years, with applications from 1 April.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: As part of our continued efforts to drive transformation under the BE ITM, the Government will introduce a new Built Environment Technology and Capability (BETC) Grant to further support the development of long-term capabilities of all firms in the sector.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: One hundred million dollars will be set aside over a five-year period for the grant, which will accept applications from 1 April.

sections.label: Land Intensification Allowance extended
sections.summary: MOF announced the LIA scheme will be extended until end-2030, giving tax allowance on capital investment in ICPHs.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: MOF has announced the Land Intensification Allowance (LIA) scheme will be extended until the end of 2030, which allows companies investing in Integrated Construction and Prefabrication Hubs (ICPHs), to receive tax allowance on their capital investment.

sections.label: HR transformation support collaboration
sections.summary: SIA, ACES and IHRP will collaborate to roll out HR transformation support to help firms enhance career development support.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: We have also heard in-service professionals requesting more career development opportunities and improved HR support.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: I am pleased to announce a new collaboration amongst SIA, ACES and the Institute for HR Professionals (IHRP) to roll out HR transformation support to help firms enhance career development support.

sections.label: Tender evaluation against low outlier bids
sections.summary: Low outlier bid awards declined from 2017 to 2024, and the Government will expand tender evaluation to disadvantage such bids.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The proportion of tenders awarded to low outlier bids has declined significantly from 2017 to 2024, with the majority of public sector tenders awarded to the top-quality bids.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The Government will further expand our tender evaluation approach to disadvantage low outlier bids for a wider range of public sector projects.

sections.label: One-stop transformation programme compilation
sections.summary: BCA will put together a one-stop compilation of programmes and initiatives supporting firms to transform capabilities and upskill employees.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: To guide more firms and BE professionals to embark on their transformation journeys, I am pleased to announce that BCA will put together a one-stop compilation of the programmes and initiatives that support firms to transform their capabilities and upskill their employees.

sections.label: Lactation room code recommendations
sections.summary: The Code Review Committee recommended lowering the GFA threshold for lactation rooms and expanding mandatory features such as seats and side tables.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The Code Review Committee has recommended to: first, lower the GFA threshold for the provision of lactation rooms; and second, expand the list of mandatory features that lactation rooms are to be equipped with, such as seats and side tables.

sections.label: Budget meals at HDB coffeeshops
sections.summary: As of January 2025, over 60% of 397 HDB rental coffeeshops and about 30% of 403 privately-owned HDB coffeeshops offer budget meals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: As of January 2025, more than 60% of 397 HDB rental coffeeshops and about 30% of 403 privately-owned HDB coffeeshops now offer budget meals.

sections.label: Onboarding HDB rental coffeeshops
sections.summary: Plans continue to make budget meals available at more locations, with all HDB rental coffeeshops on track by 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: We will continue with our plans to make budget meals available at even more locations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: We are on track to onboard all HDB rental coffee shops to provide budget meals by 2026.

sections.label: ORA renewal budget meal condition
sections.summary: From May 2025, privately-owned HDB coffeeshops renewing ORA applications must offer budget meals as a renewal condition.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: From May 2025 onwards, when privately-owned coffeeshops in HDB estates renew their application to use the Outdoor Refreshment Area (ORA), HDB will also require these coffee shops to offer budget meals as one of the conditions for renewal.

sections.label: Reviewing PQM and rental renewal
sections.summary: The Price-Quality Method framework is being reviewed to raise quality weightage and account for stall-level charges, and HDB's rental renewal policy is being reviewed to deter overly high bids.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: First, we are reviewing the Price-Quality Method (PQM) framework to increase the weightage of quality and take into account stall-level charges that prospective coffeeshop operators will impose on stallholders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Second, we are reviewing HDB’s rental renewal policy to deter overly high rental bids for HDB rental shops and coffeeshops, to ensure that stallholders can continue to operate sustainably.

sections.label: Town funding for projects
sections.summary: Between FY2021 and FY2024, top five towns received $14.2 million to $21.1 million, bottom five $11.0 million to $4.9 million, with Aljunied-Hougang the exception.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Based on the funding approved to date, between FY2021 and FY 2024, the top five towns are Ang Mo Kio, Pasir Ris-Punggol, Jurong-Clementi, West Coast and Sembawang, with funding ranging from $14.2 million to $21.1 million.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: The bottom five towns are Aljunied-Hougang, Marsiling-Yew Tee, East Coast, Holland-Bukit Panjang and Bishan-Toa Payoh with approved funding ranging from $11.0 million to $4.9 million.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: The exception is Aljunied-Hougang, which has 62,000 HDB flats – a mid-sized town with the lowest funding approved across towns.

sections.label: Aljunied/Hougang project approvals
sections.summary: Aljunied/Hougang submitted the fewest projects, 18 totalling $1.2 million, and CIPC gave in-principle approval to all 18.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Aljunied/Hougang submitted the fewest projects: 18 projects for a total of $1.2 million, and CIPC gave in-principle approval to all 18 projects.

sections.label: Pasir Ris-Punggol resident satisfaction
sections.summary: Resident satisfaction rose 15 percentage points in the first six months in Pasir Ris-Punggol, with over 30% speedier response and case resolution despite three times the area.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Resident satisfaction increased by 15 percentage points in the first six months of operation in Pasir Ris-Punggol, on the back of more than 30% speedier response and true case resolution, despite three times the area of operations.

sections.label: Hoarder refusal and CDRT claims
sections.summary: If a hoarder refuses assistance or assessment, affected residents can file a claim with CDRT and apply for a Mandatory Treatment Order.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: If the hoarder refuses assistance or assessment, affected residents can file a claim with the Community Disputes Resolution Tribunal (CDRT) and apply to CDRT for a Mandatory Treatment Order.

sections.label: Budget Meal programme expansion
sections.summary: The Government will expand the Budget Meal programme, onboard all HDB rental coffeeshops by 2026, and review the PQM framework and HDB rental renewal policy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: (In Mandarin):   The Government will expand the Budget Meal programme to more locations to benefit more people.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: We are on track to onboard all HDB rental coffeeshops to provide budget meals by 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Starting from May this year, HDB will require privately-owned coffeeshops seeking to renew their application to use the outdoor refreshment area, to provide budget meals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: First, we are reviewing the Price Quality Method (PQM) framework to increase the weightage on quality and take into account stall level charges that prospective coffeeshop operators will impose on stallholders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Second, we are reviewing HDB's rental renewal policy to deter overly high rental bids for HDB rental shops and coffeeshops.

sections.label: Parks and park connectors progress
sections.summary: The 2021 target of 130 hectares of new parks by 2026 was achieved, 391 kilometres of park connectors exist as of end 2024, and more are targeted.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: First, we have achieved our 2021 target of developing 130 hectares of new parks by 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Second, to make green spaces even more accessible for Singaporeans, as of end 2024, we have established 391 kilometres of park connectors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: This is equivalent to crossing Singapore's length from East to West almost eight times.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: We are making good progress towards achieving our target of 500 kilometres of park connectors by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: With eight parks and 13 kilometres of park connectors added to our pipeline of green spaces, we target to develop more than 25 new parks and over 50 kilometres of park connectors, which Singaporeans can look forward to over the next five years.

sections.label: HDB blocks with lift access
sections.summary: Around 99% of all HDB blocks were built with direct lift access or have benefited from the Lift Upgrading Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Today, around 99% of all HDB blocks were either built with direct lift access or has benefitted from the Lift Upgrading Programme, or LUP.

sections.label: Nature Kakis and OneMillionTrees
sections.summary: Since the Nature Kakis Network launched in 2023, 23 Chapters and over 250 stewards were established, and over 760,000 trees planted since 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: For example, since the Nature Kakis Network was launched in 2023, we have established 23 Chapters islandwide with over 250 Nature Kaki stewards.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: NParks also works with community members on the OneMillionTrees Movement, which has planted more than 760,000 trees, including forest and mangrove trees, since 2020.

sections.label: Coral restoration efforts launched
sections.summary: A programme launched last December aims to scale up coral restoration over 10 years and beyond, focusing on rarer species like Staghorn coral.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Launched last December, it aims to scale up our coral restoration efforts over the next 10 years and beyond, with focus on the recovery of rarer species, like the Staghorn coral.

sections.label: Pet cat sterilisation progress
sections.summary: An update on the Framework noted that 97% of pet cats licensed to HDB flats to date have been sterilised.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Last month, I gave a more comprehensive update on the progress of the Framework.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: We are encouraged to see that 97% of pet cats licensed to HDB flats to date have already been sterilised.

sections.label: Pigeon pilot and therapeutic gardens
sections.summary: A pigeon management pilot saw reduced feedback in three Town Councils, and there are now 17 therapeutic gardens towards a target of 30 by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Everyone plays a part in keeping our estates clean.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: We also launched a pigeon management pilot last year, which included a customised plan for participating Town Councils and guidelines for direct population control.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: The number of pigeon-related feedback across the three Town Councils under the pilot – Bishan-Toa Payoh, Ang Mo Kio and Tanjong Pagar – has decreased between July to December 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: We are evaluating the pilot's outcomes further and plan to expand the initiative to other Town Councils.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: (In Mandarin):   We have been working hard to make our green spaces more inclusive.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: We now have 17 therapeutic gardens in parks across the island, more than halfway towards our target of 30 gardens by 2030.

sections.label: Flat selection and rental flats
sections.summary: HDB streamlined flat selection and cut waiting times to an average of five months, and will build close to 5,000 more public rental flats by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Since then, HDB has streamlined the flat selection process and reduced waiting times to an average of five months.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: As part of our efforts, we will build another close to 5,000 public rental flats by 2030.

sections.label: Completion of HDB blocks
sections.summary: HDB has completed six such blocks and will complete another 28 in the next five years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: HDB has completed six such blocks and will complete another 28 in the next five years.

sections.label: Fresh Start for ComLink+ families
sections.summary: Fresh Start will be extended to first-timer ComLink+ families in public rental, letting them buy a 2- or 3-room Standard flat on a shorter lease.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: First, we will extend Fresh Start to first-timer ComLink+ families in public rental, to allow them to buy a 2- or 3-room Standard flat on a shorter lease.

sections.label: Public rental households move in
sections.summary: More than 700 public rental households moved into their new flat last year, like Mdm Nureezan.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Like Mdm Nureezan, more than 700 public rental households moved into their new flat last year.

sections.label: Fresh Start Housing Scheme extension
sections.summary: 85 families have moved in and 28 booked flats under the Fresh Start Housing Scheme, which will extend to first-timer ComLink+ families in public rental.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: To date, 85 families have moved into their flats through support from the Fresh Start Housing Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Another 28 families have booked their flat and are waiting for their keys.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: First, we will extend this scheme to first-timer ComLink+ families in public rental, to allow them to buy a 2 or 3-room Standard flat on a shorter lease, which is more affordable compared to a 99-year lease flat.

sections.label: Clarification on CIPC applications
sections.summary: The speaker corrects a missing word, saying most CIPC projects are approved and rejections generally have two reasons.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, please allow me to make a clarification.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: There was a missing word from my speech earlier, in the section where I dealt with CIPC applications.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: I should have said: "Most projects are approved.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Where they are rejected, there are generally two reasons".

sections.label: NRP and ROH programmes
sections.summary: The Neighbourhood Renewal Programme improves estate, precinct and neighbourhood livability, while the Revitalisation of Heartlands programme rejuvenates towns as a whole.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Around the home there is the Neighbourhood Renewal Programme (NRP) and this seeks to improve the livability of the estate, the precinct as well as the neighbourhood.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But at the higher level we also have the Revitalisation of Heartlands (ROH) programme and this is a programme that roves around different towns and seeks to rejuvenate the town as a whole.

sections.label: Scanning technology pilot for seepage
sections.summary: A scanning technology pilot will start with 70 flats to pinpoint external wall seepage and target repairs at the source.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: I am sure the Member would be familiar with it, when you have external wall seepage, you think the water is leaking from this place, but actually there could be micro cracks in other parts of the external surface that caused this water to accumulate and then enter the home.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And so, this scanning technology is a pilot and we are going to start with 70 flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And having pinpointed it, we hope that the repair method will so called nip the problem in the bud at the source, and hopefully the solution becomes a lot more durable, because then you try to target where the problem is.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And so, no specific towns per se, but HDB will identify 70 flats for a start to see whether this technology, coupled with the follow-up repair, achieves results.

sections.label: Community Care Apartments target
sections.summary: There is no change to the earlier target to build 30 Community Care Apartments by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The second question is on Community Care Apartments, no change to the earlier target to build 30 Community Care Apartments by 2030.

sections.label: HDB rental coffee shop budget meals
sections.summary: HDB officers continue to stay in touch with operators in HDB rental coffee shops regarding budget meals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: In response to Mr Chong Kee Hiong's question about budget meals, our officers at HDB continue to stay in touch with the operators in our HDB rental coffee shops.

sections.label: Singapore Green Plan 2030 targets
sections.summary: This was one of the pillars under the Singapore Green Plan 2030, with longer-term targets mostly pegged to 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: This was one of the pillars under the Singapore Green Plan 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We have put in place a set of longer-term targets, mostly pegged to 2030, to ensure that we keep on track to make our aspirations a reality.

sections.label: Reviewing City in Nature targets
sections.summary: City in Nature targets will be reviewed in the context of the broader Green Plan 2030, with targets beyond 2030 considered.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Looking at the City in Nature targets, it is a timely opportunity for us to review them and we will do so.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We are doing so not just under our City in Nature targets, but also in context of the broader Green Plan 2030 that involves many agencies and other Ministries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We will consider the next bound of our targets beyond 2030 and we will chart our approach beyond that.

sections.label: Ageing in place and right-sizing options
sections.summary: Seniors can age in place, use EASE, do a Lease Buyback, right-size, and get the enhanced Silver Housing Bonus from 1 December.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, they age in place, make the home safer through EASE and do a Lease Buyback to allow them to gain an additional income stream for retirement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: They, of course, can right-size, by buying a smaller BTO flat or a 2-room Flexi flat on a shorter lease, and in doing so, get extra support through the enhanced Silver Housing Bonus, which will be enhanced from 1 December of this year.

sections.label: Scoping consultants' liabilities and insurance
sections.summary: The task force and review will look at scoping consultants' liabilities more fairly, including limitation of liability clauses and PII coverage.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: And consequently, the attractiveness of the BE careers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, what we are doing in the task force, and what the review will do, is look at ways to better scope consultants' liabilities to be fairer.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: One area being studied is the use of limitation of liability clauses, which will enable consultants to procure professional indemnity insurance (PII) coverage to manage liabilities that may arise.

sections.label: BETC grant key areas
sections.summary: The BETC grant supports initiatives in three key areas: enterprise, technology and manpower.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: With respect to the other question on the details of the BETC grant, the BETC grant supports initiatives in three key areas: first, enterprise; second, technology; and third, manpower.

sections.label: Cooling measures not discussed
sections.summary: The Member's suggestion to discuss cooling measures is not taken up because market cooling measures are sensitive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: On the Member's specific suggestion, we do not discuss cooling measures because of the sensitive nature of market cooling measures.

sections.label: Pilot results require everyone's part
sections.summary: The pilot results are encouraging, but the takeaways require everyone, not just the Town Council or HDB, to play their part.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The results are encouraging but one of the most important set of takeaways from the pilot it really requires – it is not just the Town Council or HDB – but requires everyone to play our part.

sections.label: SFA tray return and bird measures
sections.summary: SFA works with hawker centre operators to retrofit tray return tracks and add protective netting where bird nuisances were reported, and the pilot results are being evaluated for extension to more Town Councils.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: For example, SFA is working with hawker centre operators to retrofit tray return tracks, having protective netting at food establishments where the bird nuisances were reported to minimise the food source availability for such birds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: So, there are things that we can do; practical, sensible steps that we can do.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: We are evaluating the results of the pilot and we will see how we can extend it to more Town Councils.

sections.label: Working with NParks on crows
sections.summary: Under the TC-managed tree regime, work with NParks can expedite removal of crow nests and stem crow population growth, with NParks deploying trained contractors and operators.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: For example, as part of the TC-managed tree regime, how can we work together with NParks to expedite the removal of crow nest and to stem the growth of the crow populations and NParks will deploy trained contractors and operators for such operations.
